# Nth Dimension Academy

> Nth Dimension Academy is the certification training practice of Navakanth Reddy Dumpa, a Microsoft Certified Trainer (MCT) and Master Consultant with 14+ years of enterprise experience. The academy delivers structured, certification-aligned training and real-world mentoring in the Microsoft Fabric and Azure data ecosystem, focused on Medallion Architecture, Microsoft Fabric, and Azure Databricks.

## Who it's for

Data engineers, analytics engineers, and BI/data professionals preparing for Microsoft data certification exams, and organizations that need enterprise-grade Fabric/Databricks enablement delivered by a Microsoft Certified Trainer.

## What it offers

- Instructor-led and self-paced exam prep for Microsoft Fabric and Azure Databricks certifications
- "Learning Atlas" study resources per exam (structured syllabi, curriculum maps, and practice material)
- Real-world project mentoring and Medallion Architecture design guidance
- Corporate/enterprise Fabric and Databricks training engagements

## Certifications covered

- DP-600: Implementing Analytics Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric — /dp600-atlas/
- DP-700: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric — /dp700-atlas/
- DP-750: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Azure Databricks — /dp750-atlas/
- DP-800: Implementing a Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse — /dp800-atlas/
- AI-103: Azure AI Foundry — /ai103-atlas/
